root.name: エドワーズ・ライフサイエンシズ

relations.text: 経皮的大動脈弁置換(TAVR)で、主要な競合の一社である
relations.text_en: Medtronic is a primary competitor in TAVR

source.label: エドワーズ・ライフサイエンシズ 10-K(2025-12-31)
source.quote: In TAVR, our primary competitors include Medtronic plc (“Medtronic”) and Abbott Laboratories (“Abbott”)

relations.text: 構造的心疾患の特許について、15年間の相互不訴訟契約を結んでいる
relations.text_en: Edwards entered into an agreement with Medtronic for a 15-year global covenant not to sue over certain structural heart patents

source.label: エドワーズ・ライフサイエンシズ 10-K(2025-12-31)
source.quote: On April 12, 2023, we entered into an intellectual property agreement with Medtronic pursuant to which the parties agreed to a 15-year global covenant not to sue ("CNS") for infringement of certain patents in the structural heart space owned or controlled by each other.

companies.name: アボット・ラボラトリーズ

relations.text: TAVRのほか、僧帽弁・三尖弁治療でも主要な競合となる
relations.text_en: Abbott is a primary competitor in TAVR and in TMTT

source.label: エドワーズ・ライフサイエンシズ 10-K(2025-12-31)
source.quote: In TMTT, our primary competitor is Abbott, and there are a considerable number of large and small companies with development efforts in these fields.

companies.name: ジェナバルブ・テクノロジー

relations.text: 買収に先立ち、ジェナバルブへつなぎ融資を行う契約を結んでいた
relations.text_en: Edwards agreed to provide bridge loan funding to JenaValve alongside the merger agreement

source.label: エドワーズ・ライフサイエンシズ 10-K(2025-12-31)
source.quote: Concurrently, the Company entered into a Promissory Note agreement (the “Bridge Loan”) under which it agreed to provide funding to JenaValve for up to $ 75.0 million

relations.text: 買収は差止命令を受け、双方は合併契約を終了させた
relations.text_en: The acquisition was enjoined and the two companies terminated the merger agreement

source.label: エドワーズ・ライフサイエンシズ 10-K(2025-12-31)
source.quote: On January 14, 2026, the Company and JenaValve entered into an incremental agreement terminating the Merger Agreement.

relations.text: 心臓弁の競合としてエドワーズを記載
relations.text_en: Names Edwards Lifesciences as a heart-valve competitor

source.label: Artivion 10-K
source.quote: We compete with bioprosthetic or mechanical valves from companies including Medtronic, Edwards Lifesciences, Corcym, and Abbott Laboratories.

companies.name: メリット・メディカル・システムズ
companies.sub: 心臓・血管インターベンション機器

relations.text: 心臓インターベンションの主要な競合としてエドワーズを記載
relations.text_en: Names Edwards Lifesciences as a primary cardiac-intervention competitor

source.label: Merit Medical 10-K
source.quote: Our primary competitors in our cardiac intervention market are BD, Teleflex, Medtronic, Abbott Laboratories, Terumo Corporation, Edwards Lifesciences Corporation

note.ja: 公式資料で確認できた関係だけを載せています。投資判断を勧めるものではありません。
note.en: Only relationships confirmed in official materials are shown. Not investment advice.
